title: Truchas 2D flow simulation input
description: Complete input for a standalone two-dimensional incompressible flow simulation.

materials.description: Named material definitions used by the simulation. Without material-regions, define exactly one material.

material-regions.description: Optional geometric or cell-set assignment of materials to the mesh.

flow-model.description: Incompressible flow model and boundary conditions.

flow-solver.description: Flow time-stepping, volume-tracking, and linear-solver controls.

initial-velocity.description: Optional initial velocity field. It may be a constant vector or an inline vector function, but it must evaluate to exactly two components; if omitted, the initial velocity is zero.
